items.title: Mandel Johnny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: It’s in Ted Gioia’s book called, “West Coast Jazz,” apparently when he was putting together that group with Buddy Collette…

Yeah, I gotta be honest with you I never was a convert to West Coast jazz, I always thought was a very kind of weak cousin to East Coast jazz; in fact I just never identified it as something in itself really. I always liked the way the east coasters played but I like living on the West Coast. I always thought there was something a little effeminate about the way they played, not that that’s bad, it’s just not something – you know you come out of Basie and some of the most hard swinging kind of things and…
